_comment: Centralized backend-only OAuth configuration for every MCP integration -- client IDs, secrets, and the shared redirect URL. Copy this file to ~/.HRAgent/oauth_providers.json (or set OH_OAUTH_PROVIDERS_CONFIG_PATH to point elsewhere, e.g. a different file per dev/staging/prod environment) and fill in real values there -- never commit real credentials. See mcp_integration/oauth_provider_config.py for details.
_redirect_uri_comment: Every provider app below must register this exact callback URL. Only the port is actually used (the callback is always a local loopback listener) -- change it here (and in each provider's app settings) if 8765 is already in use, or when deploying somewhere the port needs to differ.

google._comment: Google Cloud Console -> APIs & Services -> Credentials -> Create Credentials -> OAuth client ID -> Application type: Desktop app. Add the redirect_uri above under Authorized redirect URIs. Used by gmail, google-drive, google-calendar, google-chat, google-people.

slack._comment: api.slack.com/apps -> Create New App -> OAuth & Permissions -> add the redirect_uri above as a Redirect URL, and enable MCP server access under the app's Assistant settings.

github._comment: github.com/settings/developers -> OAuth Apps -> New OAuth App. Set the Authorization callback URL to the redirect_uri above.

_providers_comment: Providers not listed here (Linear, Notion, Jira/Atlassian) support dynamic client registration and need no entry -- they're always ready to connect without any backend setup.
